Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:51pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup chopped celery
1/2 cup chopped onion
2 tablespoons butter
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked
2 cups Minute Rice, cooked
1 can Cheddar cheese soup or 1 can cream of chicken soup
2 cups chopped, cooked chicken or ham may be substituted

Preparation

1 Saute celery and onions in butter in skillet. Mix with remaining ingredients in bowl. Pour into 9x13 baking dish. Bake 350 degrees for 45-60 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 12 servings.
